1 (Currently Amended): An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, wherein the control means is configured to operate the first and second valves in a manner that is distinct from the operation of the valves in Pannbacker, Wachi, and Frank.

5 (Currently Amended): The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by binary actuators that are configured to respond to control signals in a manner that is distinct from the operation described in Pannbacker, Wachi, and Frank. 

9 (Currently Amended): An air braking system comprising one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank, wherein the system is configured to operate in a manner that is distinct from the systems described in Pannbacker, Wachi, and Frank.
